user.title: Mitsubishi Comfort Setup
user.description: Enter your Kumo Cloud credentials to connect your Mitsubishi climate control system.

site.title: Select Site
site.description: Select the site you want to control. You have {num_sites} available sites.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your Kumo Cloud credentials need to be updated. Please enter your current password.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Kumo Cloud. Please check your internet connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

init.title: Mitsubishi Comfort Options
init.description: Configure options for your Mitsubishi Comfort integration.

no_setpoint_in_dry.message: {name} does not accept a target temperature in dry mode.

no_setpoint_in_mode.message: {name} has no target temperature in {mode} mode.

no_loaded_entry.message: No Mitsubishi Comfort account is set up.

entry_id_required.message: More than one account is set up, so this service needs config_entry_id to know which one you mean.

unknown_entry.message: No loaded Mitsubishi Comfort account with id {entry_id}.

unknown_season.message: No schedule season called {season}. Known seasons: {known}.

no_season.message: This account has no schedule seasons.

no_schedules.message: This season has no schedules to clear.

get_schedules.name: Get schedules
get_schedules.description: Returns the running season's schedule for every zone, with the next change worked out in each zone's own timezone.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to read. Only needed when more than one is set up.

set_season.name: Set schedule season
set_season.description: Makes a schedule season the active one.

season.name: Season
season.description: The season's name, as shown in the Comfort app.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to change. Only needed when more than one is set up.

set_hold.name: Set hold
set_hold.description: Pins settings on one or more zones until the hold is cleared or expires. This is what the Comfort app calls Away mode. Leave the zone empty to hold every zone.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the hold on or off.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Which zone to hold. Leave empty for all of them.

hold_type.name: Hold type
hold_type.description: until_next_event releases at the next scheduled change; permanent stays until you clear it.

operation_mode.name: Operation mode
operation_mode.description: Mode to hold. Defaults to what the zone is doing now.

cool_setpoint.name: Cool setpoint
cool_setpoint.description: In Celsius. Defaults to the zone's current value.

heat_setpoint.name: Heat setpoint
heat_setpoint.description: In Celsius. Defaults to the zone's current value.

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: Raw API fan speed. Defaults to the zone's current value.

air_direction.name: Air direction
air_direction.description: Raw API vane position. Defaults to the zone's current value.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to change. Only needed when more than one is set up.

set_schedule.name: Set a zone's schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces one zone's scheduled events. Whatever you pass becomes the whole timetable for that zone, and an empty list clears it.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The zone's name, as shown in the Comfort app.

events.name: Events
events.description: A list of events. Each needs days (Mo, Tu, We, Th, Fr, Sa, Su), start_time as HHMM, and operation_mode. Optionally fan_speed, air_direction, cool_setpoint and heat_setpoint, in Celsius.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to change. Only needed when more than one is set up.

set_schedules_enabled.name: Enable or disable schedules
set_schedules_enabled.description: Starts or stops the running schedule season, which is how scheduling is turned on and off.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to change. Only needed when more than one is set up.

clear_season_events.name: Clear season events
clear_season_events.description: Deletes every scheduled event in a season, leaving the season itself. This cannot be undone.

season.name: Season
season.description: The season to clear. Defaults to the running one.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to change. Only needed when more than one is set up.

set_auto_dry.name: Set Auto Dry
set_auto_dry.description: Turns Auto Dry on or off. Auto Dry runs dry mode to pull humidity down without letting the room get cold. This is a service rather than a switch because nothing reports the setting back: the cloud accepts the change but will not say what a unit is set to, so there is no state to show and no way to confirm it was applied. Leave the zone empty to set every zone.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Auto Dry on or off.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Which zone to set. Leave empty for all of them.

target_humidity.name: Target humidity
target_humidity.description: Relative humidity to aim for, as a percentage. Left alone if not given.

overcool.name: Overcool
overcool.description: How far below the setpoint the unit may cool while drying, in degrees. Left alone if not given.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: Temperature offset the unit applies while drying. Left alone if not given.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which account to act on. Only needed with more than one configured.
